code: ClearAll[n,nr,f,x,p,ee,mu,h,t,p0,p1,n0,n1,s]; x=Log[n/nr];ee=n f[x];p=n Derivative[1][f][x];mu=f[x]+Derivative[1][f][x];first=FullSimplify[D[ee,n]-mu,n>0&&nr>0];euler=FullSimplify[ee+p-n mu];sound=FullSimplify[D[p,n]/D[ee,n]-(Derivative[1][f][x]+Derivative[2][f][x])/(f[x]+Derivative[1][f][x]),n>0&&nr>0];hp=(2 t^3-3 t^2+1)p0+(t^3-2t^2+t)h n0+(-2t^3+3t^2)p1+(t^3-t^2)h n1;d0=FullSimplify[(D[hp,{t,2}]/h^2/.t->0)/.p1->p0+h s];d1=FullSimplify[(D[hp,{t,2}]/h^2/.t->1)/.p1->p0+h s];ExportString[<|"first_law_residual"->first,"Euler_residual"->euler,"sound_speed_residual"->sound,"Hermite_dndmu_left"->ToString[d0,InputForm],"Hermite_dndmu_right"->ToString[d1,InputForm],"latent_identity_residual"->Expand[(muT nH-pT)-(muT nL-pT)-muT(nH-nL)]|>,"RawJSON"]
